name: city_05
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production square Three Kingdoms Chinese strategy-game city battlefield background. One distinct original city composition, not a color swap. Polished AA-oriented semi-realistic hand-painted 2.5D environment, crisp readable material edges and refined brushwork, authentic Han-era details. Orthographic very steep overhead camera, no sky or horizon, one continuous flat ground plane. The central 80 percent is EMPTY freely traversable paving or earth, with continuous empty routes reaching all four edges. Scenery is sparse and restricted to the outermost 10 percent/corners, never blocking movement or creating corridors. Gentle warm sunlight, restrained contact shadows near the perimeter only. Natural harmonious colors that fit a warm ivory rice-paper and antique-gold Chinese game UI. Ground material has fine small-scale details but low overall contrast so cards read clearly. Absolutely no people, units, cards, UI, text, signs, watermarks, bridge, river, pond, stairs, central building, central props, road-blocking walls or big diamond/checkerboard paving. Square image. Theme: 宛城 Wancheng: warm grey small irregular rectangular stone paving, discreet pine branches and a few rustic ceramic jars only at far outside corners; small Han wooden shop eaves cropped at perimeter; large clean open courtyard.
